    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies RPC argument handling and deprecation errors for non-wallet RPCs in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Deprecating the redundant replaceable argument in raw transaction and PSBT RPCs provides orderly API deprecation discipline. With full-RBF prevalent, maintaining opt-in signaling parameters is redundant API complexity, though handling the deprecation is reasonably deferrable."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The minor addition to src/util/rbf.h directly supports the wallet and RPC deprecation logic rather than general utility infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change to src/util/rbf.h only follows the needs of the RPC and wallet deprecation."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Wallet label and modifies transaction creation and fee-bumping RPCs in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp and src/wallet/spend.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removing the replaceable parameter simplifies wallet transaction creation options that became redundant with default full-RBF. It resolves issue #32661 and prepares for eventual removal of opt-in signaling complexity, but represents deferrable API cleanup."
    }
